name: progress-bar
title: Progress Bar
description: A progress bar component indicating the completion status of a task with multiple color options.

migration.guide: API changed: import as namespace `import * as ProgressBar from ...`, use `<ProgressBar.Root value={50} />` instead of `<ProgressBar progress={50} />`. The `variant` prop is replaced by `color` ('blue' | 'red' | 'orange' | 'green' | 'primary' | 'neutral'). The `progress` prop is renamed to `value` with a configurable `max`.

docs.lead: A progress bar component to show the completion status of a task or process, with multiple color options.
docs.usage:
import * as ProgressBar from "@/components/ui/progress-bar"

<ProgressBar.Root value={50} max={100} color="blue" />

examples.title: Color
examples.description: Progress bars in all available colors: blue (default), red, orange, green, primary, and neutral.
examples.code:
<ProgressBar.Root value={50} color="blue" />
<ProgressBar.Root value={50} color="red" />
<ProgressBar.Root value={50} color="primary" />
<ProgressBar.Root value={50} color="neutral" />

examples.description: A progress bar with an inline percentage label.
